# AIAO

> Vendor-neutral AI Agent Optimization for mission-driven, resource-constrained organizations.

AIAO helps organizations present their value so AI agents can understand, find, and recommend them — without locking anyone into a single model or cloud vendor.

Site: https://www.aiao.tech/
Email: contact@aiao.tech
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/mei-hsien-hsu/
Location: San Francisco Bay Area and remote
Languages: Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant), English, Spanish

## Founder

Mei-Hsien Hsu (許美嫻) founded AIAO. She spent 16 years in community programs and bilingual operations at Tzu Chi USA, and is formally trained in machine learning and statistics. Credentials include a Machine Learning & AI Certificate (2026) and AWS Cloud Foundations.

## Services

1. AI readability audit — have an AI agent actually read the client's site and report every place it cannot understand, see, or recommend them.
2. Content restructuring — rewrite story, services, and expertise into the structure and language AI cites most easily (EN / 中文 / ES).
3. Structured data — schema, llms.txt, semantic HTML, so agents identify the organization correctly.
4. Ongoing optimization — models change; regular review keeps the organization visible.

## Positioning

- Vendor-neutral: deliverables (structure, copy, markup) belong to the client and travel across tools.
- Built for nonprofits, faith and community groups, and small bilingual teams.
- First consultation is free: an AI agent reads the site and reports whether it can currently see the organization.
